messages:
Rina: Quick sync on the timeline mini-heatmap + compact scrubber. Current design uses small colored dots only to indicate stage states (active/paused/failed). Accessibility feedback says color-only isn't enough. Link to current frame: https://redwood.design/figma/timeline-v2.png :link: Omar: Agreed. For small dots we should add pattern fills for non-running states (paused = diagonal stripes, failed = cross-hatch). Also consider a 10px tappable hit area for mobile. Priya D: Copy question: heatmap tooltip currently shows 'canary 10%'. Should we change to 'Canary — 10%' or 'Canary (10%)'? PMs prefer the em-dash for logs. Evan: UX tradeoff: em-dash is clear in logs but tooltip space is limited. I'd go with 'Canary · 10%' (middle dot) for compactness. Screen readers get full text via aria-label. axs-bot: Accessibility check: color contrast not applicable for tiny decorative dots. Recommend additional non-color cue and accessible name for each dot. Rina: So plan: add pattern icons + aria-label per dot, and update tooltip microcopy to middle dot. Also keyboard behavior: tabbing should land on the stage card, but we want left/right arrow to scrub through timeline. Thoughts? Omar: Arrow scrub is intuitive. Implement roving focus within timeline with role="listbox" + aria-activedescendant. Example snippet: ```
...
``` Priya D: Nice. For the aria-label wording, prefer full words for SR: 'Canary, 10 percent, paused' — avoid symbols like '%' which screen readers may read inconsistently. Evan: Also want live region for status changes so assistive tech hears 'Canary scaled to 20 percent' when traffic changes. Use aria-live="polite" on a hidden status region. Rina: Excellent. Now rollback affordance: design currently shows rollback in the flyout with a red inline CTA. Concern: accidental rollback via keyboard shortcuts or muscle memory. Omar: Require a modal with keyboard trap + typed confirm (type the version number). Modal should prevent Enter from accidentally submitting until typed string matches. Example copy: 'Type "rollback-4" to confirm rollback to v4'. Priya D: Let's standardize typed confirm pattern across products. Use prefix 'rollback-' + version to make it unambiguous. Add aria-describedby explaining why typed confirm is needed. Evan: For color semantics: use orange for paused/warning states, red for destructive (failed/rollback). Update tokens: --state-paused: brand-amber-500; --state-destructive: brand-red-600. Ensure contrast for icons and text. axs-bot: Accessibility test cases to add: 1) each timeline dot has aria-label and role=option; 2) arrow keys move aria-activedescendant; 3) live region announces status updates; 4) rollback modal requires typed match and focuses input on open. Rina: Design tasks: 1) pattern fills for paused/failed 2) add mini pause icon for paused dots 3) update tooltip copy to 'Canary · 10%' and set aria-label to 'Canary, 10 percent, paused' 4) figma frames for keyboard focus states. Can design deliver prototypes by tomorrow noon? :hourglass_flowing_sand: Omar: I'll prototype the pattern svgs and keyboard behavior in code sandbox and link it. Priya D: I'll draft the copy guidelines and typed-confirm spec. Evan: I'll add the live-region helper and exceptions to the a11y playbook. Rina: Great. Last small item: history scrubber thumb needs a larger focus ring. Current 2px ring is too subtle. Propose 4px with 4px offset and motion on focus. Omar: Agreed. CSS proposal: `.scrubber:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(59,130,246,0.25); }` Rina: Perfect. I'll collect design + dev PR links in this thread once ready. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
